audience: people and teams who manage connected Google or Office 365 calendars through Cronofy

useCases.title: See what is on your calendars this week
useCases.text: The AI reads events across all connected calendars over a time window and lists them in order.

useCases.title: Find open time for a meeting
useCases.text: The AI reads the busy times across your calendars for a time window and finds gaps long enough for the meeting.

useCases.title: Add or change a calendar event
useCases.text: The AI creates an event on one of your calendars, or updates an existing event by its event id. It writes to the real calendar.

useCases.title: Delete an event from a calendar
useCases.text: The AI finds the event in a time window and deletes it from the calendar by event id.

useCases.title: Check which calendars and accounts are connected
useCases.text: The AI lists the calendars you can see and the connected calendar profiles, such as Google or Office 365.
